SELECT
  'pu-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-item_purchase-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z' AS batch_id,
  '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST('${date-1d}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
  CAST(o.supplier_num AS BIGINT) AS supplier_num,
  CAST(o.supplier_code AS VARCHAR) AS supplier_code,
  CAST(o.supplier_name AS VARCHAR) AS supplier_name,
  CAST(o.item_num AS BIGINT) AS item_num,
  CAST(o.item_code AS VARCHAR) AS item_code,
  CAST(o.item_barcode AS VARCHAR) AS item_barcode,
  CAST(o.item_name AS VARCHAR) AS item_name,
  CAST(o.item_spec AS VARCHAR) AS item_spec,
  CAST(o.base_unit AS VARCHAR) AS base_unit,
  CAST(o.purchase_item_amount AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS purchase_item_amount,
  CAST(o.purchase_item_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS purchase_item_money,
  CAST(o.purchase_present_amount AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS purchase_present_amount,
  CAST(o.purchase_present_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS purchase_present_money,
  CAST(o.purchase_item_return_amount AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS purchase_item_return_amount,
  CAST(o.purchase_item_return_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS purchase_item_return_money,
  CAST(o.amount_total AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS amount_total,
  CAST(o.money_total AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS money_total
FROM input, UNNEST(input."rows") AS t(o)
WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT UNNEST(input."rows") FROM input))
                          <> (SELECT any_value(total_count) FROM input)
                    THEN error('ITEM_PURCHASE_ROWS_MISMATCH: len(rows) <> total_count（截断守卫，#640）')
                    ELSE 0 END) IS NOT NULL
